en: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Masudi
ar: أبو الحسن علي بن الحسين المسعودي

description.tr: 'Arapların Herodotos'u — Bağdat'tan İran, Hindistan, Sri Lanka, belki Çin ve Afrika'ya seyahat ederek 10. yüzyıl dünyasının en canlı etnografik araştırmasını üretti || Mesûdî, coğrafya, etnografya, doğa tarihi ve karşılaştırmalı medeniyet analizini birleştirerek İslam tarihyazımının kalıplarını kırdı. || [Tarih notu] İbn Haldûn, Mukaddime'de Mesûdî'yi model tarihçi olarak alıntılayarak 'tarihçiler için imam oldu' dedi.
description.en: The 'Arab Herodotus' — traveled from Baghdad to Persia, India, Sri Lanka, possibly China, Africa and back, producing the most vivid ethnographic survey of the 10th-century world || Masudi broke the mould of Islamic historiography by combining geography, ethnography, natural history and comparative civilizational analysis. He examined seven pre-Islamic civilizations (Persian, Chaldean, Greek, Egyptian, Turkish, Chinese, Indian) with analytical detachment. Hugh Kennedy calls Meadows of Gold 'probably the best introduction to the Arabic historical tradition for the non-specialist.' || [Historiographical note] Ibn Khaldun explicitly credited Masudi as a model historian in the Muqaddimah, stating he 'became an imam for historians.' De Meynard's 1861 French translation introduced Masudi to Western scholarship.
description.ar: هيرودوت العرب — سافر من بغداد إلى فارس والهند وسريلانكا وأفريقيا || كسر المسعودي قالب التأريخ الإسلامي بالجمع بين الجغرافيا والإثنوغرافيا والتاريخ الطبيعي. فحص سبع حضارات قبل إسلامية بتجرد تحليلي
